facts.fact: ONECI's director general said on 16 September 2025 that ONECI covers more than 84% of civil-status centres with a digital civil-status system linked to a national server, which is linked to the Registre national des personnes physiques.

systems.platform: digital civil-status system linked to a national server
systems.tiers: civil-status centres, national server, Registre national des personnes physiques
